title: Skeletons Bang Shield
description: This odd sound pack makes every type of skeleton sometimes play the "skeleton banging shield" meme. You won't regret downloading this!
body:
This SP makes every type of skeleton sometimes play the "skeleton banging shield" sound. _It's pretty funny._
## This pack does not replace every sound the skeletons make!
**Only 3 of the Idle, Ambient and Say sounds are changed.** (Phew!)

The "Raahhh" can have a different pitch and speed (3). You'll hear it right away when caving or spawning a skeleton, wither skeleton, stray, bogged or parched!
